transactions.description: Signed DB Robert Longerbeam from Philadelphia's practice squad.
Signed DL Austin Johnson to the practice squad.
Waived LS Beau Gardner. Designated LB Noah Sewell and DE Shemar Turner to return from the PUP list.

Signed DT Jack Heflin and WR Malik McClain from the practice squad. Placed LB Marcelino McCrary-Ball, DT David Onyemata and WR Arian Smith on injured reserve. Signed TE Cody Hardy and DT Isaiahh Loudermilk to the practice squad.
Signed LB Troy Reeder from the practice squad. Signed LB Jaden Keller and QB Will Levis to the practice squad. Released QB Bailey Zappe from the practice squad.
